name: ReviewSolicitors Widgets
author: reviewsolicitors

sections.description:
• Pick any ReviewSolicitors widget from a gallery and style it with a live preview.
  • Create as many versions of a widget as you need, for example one per office or area of law.
  • Switch each widget on or off with one click.
  • Show a widget on every page, on the home page, on chosen pages, or only where you place it.
  • Place widgets with the “ReviewSolicitors widget” block, a shortcode, or Appearance › Widgets.
  • Widgets created in your ReviewSolicitors dashboard appear in WordPress too, and changes go both ways.

Your website keeps showing your widgets even if ReviewSolicitors cannot be reached while you edit.

The plugin needs a ReviewSolicitors API token, which firms with an active Premium membership can create in their dashboard under API Settings. Custom colours need the Widget Theming add-on.

External services

This plugin relies on ReviewSolicitors (https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk), the review platform your firm’s widgets and reviews come from. It cannot work without it.

  • ReviewSolicitors API, from your WordPress site. When you connect, open the widget list, create, edit, preview, switch or delete a widget, and twice a day in the background, the plugin sends your API token and the widget settings you choose to https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/api/v2/widgets. It receives your firm’s widgets and the widget previews. No visitor data is sent.
  • ReviewSolicitors embed script, from your visitors’ browsers. On pages that show a widget, visitors’ browsers load the embed script (https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/widget/rs.js) and the widget content from ReviewSolicitors, exactly as with the copy-and-paste widget code. ReviewSolicitors receives the visitor’s IP address, browser details and the address of the page, and records that the widget was shown.

ReviewSolicitors terms and conditions: https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/terms
ReviewSolicitors privacy policy: https://www.reviewsolicitors.co.uk/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin from Plugins › Add New › Upload Plugin and activate it.
  2. Sign in to your ReviewSolicitors dashboard, open API Settings and generate a token. Under “What is this token for?” choose WordPress plugin, so the token can only manage your widgets.
  3. In WordPress, open ReviewSolicitors › Connection, paste the token and select Connect.
  4. Open ReviewSolicitors › Widgets and select Add widget.
sections.faq:
How do I place a widget inside a page?

Add the “ReviewSolicitors widget” block and pick the widget, or paste its shortcode, for example [reviewsolicitors_widget code="AbC123"]. You can copy the shortcode from the widget list.

Can I show the same widget on several pages?

Yes. Either choose “Chosen pages” under “Where it shows”, or place the block or shortcode on each page.

Can I show two widgets of the same type on one page?

Usually, yes. The Badge, Full page and Half page widgets, among others, can appear more than once on a page. If a second place stays empty or does not respond, use a different widget type there.

I use a page builder such as Elementor or Divi. Will it work?

Yes. Paste the widget’s shortcode into a Shortcode, Text or Code element, or use the “ReviewSolicitors widget” item in the builder’s WordPress widgets. The widget shows while you edit as well as on the live page.

I use a caching plugin. Do my changes show straight away?

Yes. When you switch a widget on or off, or change where it shows, the plugin clears the page cache of common caching plugins and hosts (including WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, WP Rocket, LiteSpeed Cache, WP Fastest Cache, SiteGround and WP Engine). With another cache, clear it yourself after the change.

What happens when I disconnect?

Widgets stop showing on your website until you connect again. Your widgets and their settings stay in your ReviewSolicitors account.

Which data does the plugin send?

Only the widget settings you choose, sent to ReviewSolicitors with your API token. Visitors’ browsers load the widget from ReviewSolicitors, as they do with the copy-and-paste code.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Switching a widget on or off, or changing where it shows, now clears the page cache of common caching plugins and hosts, so visitors see the change straight away.
  • Widgets now load reliably with script optimisers that defer, combine or wrap scripts (for example Autoptimize).
  • Widgets now show inside the Elementor editor and the Divi Visual Builder, and stay visible when an element is edited.
  • The widget list now shows pages where a widget was placed through Elementor’s WordPress widgets or a Divi 5 module.

1.0.0

  • First release.
